subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined word segment in the given sentence.

Take a lot of care in writing official letters because they leave __a trail behind__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence discusses the importance of taking care when writing official letters.
 
• The phrase "they leave a trail behind" implies that the letters have a lasting impact or impression.
 
• Among the given options, "a lasting impression" (Option 3) is the most appropriate substitute for the underlined segment.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Take a lot of care in writing official letters because they leave a lasting impression."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "a temporary exposure"** – This does not fit the context as it suggests something brief and not lasting.
 
• **Option 2: "a longing desire"** – This is unrelated to the context of writing letters.
 
• **Option 4: "a sound effect"** – This is not relevant to the impact of written letters.
